name: Seamless Patterns
author: TBIT DESIGN - Thomas Breher
description: Create seamless patterns with motif types, vector motif sets and searchable presets. Combine pattern layers with independent colors, motif frequencies and repeat layouts. Randomize the whole pattern, the active layer or just its colors, with locks and undo. Edit individual scatter or terrazzo elements and capture editor layers as image stamps per pattern layer. Discover botanical, wildlife, coastal, celestial and seasonal collections, save favorites, insert editable fills, or export PNG and SVG.
